scope: Accepted source annotations projected through one perturbation relation plus additive source-reported forward methodol product evidence and a generic reaction-participant context. No new project measurements, independent validation, registry admission or design-success estimate.

review_process.parent_adjudication: Accepted source annotation and generic participant relation after source, representation and visual/adversarial challenge. Exact source/code/doc pins bind the common query; model agreement is not independent validation.

resolved_objections.issue: Unmarked RA95 rows hid source-reported plus-minus magnitudes in the common uncertainty field.
resolved_objections.resolution: Generic data selectors preserve magnitude and unresolved statistic type; conflicted KM error units remain as printed.

resolved_objections.issue: Unassessed KE59 question inherited dimensionless arithmetic metadata.
resolved_objections.resolution: Unit remains null; abstention-specific interpretation and no matched control/measurement.

resolved_objections.issue: Altered assay/parameter/provider mappings could produce eligible mismatched relations.
resolved_objections.resolution: Validate source IDs, perturbation/background providers, parameter fields/units/markers, evidence/context refs and typed uncertainties. A mandatory exact review gate additionally binds curated interpretation mappings and all source references.

resolved_objections.issue: Nondetection and inconsistent stereochemical triplet needed common semantics.
resolved_objections.resolution: Normalize token/scope/detection limit without zero coercion; generic row checks read the source eligibility flag.

resolved_objections.issue: A cache claim without retained-byte verification could be mistaken for durable primary evidence.
resolved_objections.resolution: Validate witness metadata bindings; separately verify local bytes with --verify-witnesses. Public default explicitly labels cache availability unchecked.

resolved_objections.issue: The50mL/2mM/130micromol tuple is inconsistent; isolated-yield arithmetic could silently select one quantity.
resolved_objections.resolution: Retain all quantities, the100micromol dimensional check, and printed60.1%yield; block amount-normalized or repaired-yield inference.

resolved_objections.issue: Methods andS12 reverse R/S retention assignments; discarding the sourceR label would also discard its separately stated optical-rotation basis.
resolved_objections.resolution: Keep both retention maps and null normalized mapping. Retain source-assigned R-major with reported rotation/literature basis; no independent standard/reference validation.

resolved_objections.issue: Draft copied8F configuration and rotation evidence onto precursor control arms.
resolved_objections.resolution: Make shared reaction and conversion product neutral. Keep8F assignment only on its composition row; altered precursor gets caption-only assignment;0.7%arm has no configuration.

resolved_objections.issue: Strict source ee bound could become exact arithmetic, or precursor44%ee could become matched3h selectivity.
resolved_objections.resolution: Retain>98.4%and exact displayed-ratio arithmetic separately. Keep44%on1day/approximately50fold-enzyme arm; no exact altered yield or full assay reconstructed.

resolved_objections.issue: Theoretical71%yield might be treated as measured isolation or a universal equilibrium ceiling.
resolved_objections.resolution: Keep source calculation beside separate apparent-equilibrium assay; note measured0.1-1.0Macetone versus nominal2Msynthesis without refitting or extrapolation validation.

resolved_objections.issue: Old common relation had no first-class reaction participants, and repeated whole reaction objects invite scope drift.
resolved_objections.resolution: Add a generic source-bound reaction/participant primitive; one canonical reaction provider, assay reaction IDs, named sides/roles. All case chemistry stays in data; old missing contexts remain null.

resolved_objections.issue: A generic comparison block could erase the source-declared precursor control.
resolved_objections.resolution: Scope the block to generic perturbation arithmetic; preserve the exact declared descriptive precursor relation and distinct preparation IDs as structured context.

remaining_limits: Scientific classification in the mapping is computational curation, not a proof from a source hash. Changing it requires renewed review.
Comparisons are source-rounded descriptive arithmetic, not inferential statistics or causal roles.
Source witness bytes are host-local and not redistributed. No new source requests.
Full 2017 main body, KE59 supplement and RA61 earlier-study sequence/lysine controls remain unassessed where stated.

prior_review_binding.scope: Original five packets, panels and55comparison requests retained unchanged; Git preserves previous review bytes.

forward_synthesis_limits: Forward product configuration is source-assigned; R/S retention mappings remain conflicted and no assignment transfers to the0.7%precursor conversion arm.
The strict>98.4%ee remains structured source context, not a numeric central-value comparison. No repaired yield or quantity is computed.
